mapper.select: SELECT r.record_id, r.appointment_id, r.pet_id, r.client_id, r.doctor_id, r.chief_complaint, r.diagnosis, r.treatment, r.advice, r.revisit_date, r.fee_register, r.fee_treat, b.fee_drug, b.total_money, b.pay_status, r.create_time, p.pet_name, c.client_name, d.doctor_name, dep.department_name FROM medical_record r LEFT JOIN pet p ON r.pet_id = p.pet_id LEFT JOIN client c ON r.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON r.doctor_id = d.doctor_id LEFT JOIN department dep ON r.department_id = dep.department_id LEFT JOIN bill b ON b.record_id = r.record_id AND b.is_del = 0 WHERE r.is_del = 0 AND r.pet_id = #{petId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.record_id, r.appointment_id, r.pet_id, r.client_id, r.doctor_id, r.chief_complaint, r.physical_exam, r.diagnosis, r.treatment, r.advice, r.revisit_date, r.internal_note, r.fee_register, r.fee_treat, b.fee_drug, b.total_money, b.pay_status, r.create_time, p.pet_name, c.client_name, d.doctor_name, dep.department_name FROM medical_record r LEFT JOIN pet p ON r.pet_id = p.pet_id LEFT JOIN client c ON r.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON r.doctor_id = d.doctor_id LEFT JOIN department dep ON r.department_id = dep.department_id LEFT JOIN bill b ON b.record_id = r.record_id AND b.is_del = 0 WHERE r.is_del = 0 AND r.record_id = #{recordId}

SELECT r.record_id, r.pet_id, r.client_id, r.doctor_id, r.diagnosis, r.create_time, p.pet_name, c.client_name, d.doctor_name FROM medical_record r LEFT JOIN pet p ON r.pet_id = p.pet_id LEFT JOIN client c ON r.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON r.doctor_id = d.doctor_id WHERE r.is_del = 0 AND r.doctor_id = #{doctorId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
